5736.title: [4.159 Preview 1] Backport OpenJDK validation and screenshot test fixes
5736.body:
* Fix OpenJDK validation with JVM diagnostics and task retries (#5723)

Match javac's version at the start of any output line so JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS diagnostics do not reject a valid JDK. Keep exit-code and requested-major validation unchanged, and overwrite archive files on retry after a complete or partial extraction.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
(cherry picked from commit 3a23c7800aad7a08ed9369f275bc7491f188f90f)

* Synchronize post-deadline screenshot confirmation test (#5732)

* Investigate screenshot deadline regression

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Synchronize post-deadline screenshot confirmation test

The confirmation fixture wrote a matching screenshot but awaited a 20ms timer before completing capture. When that continuation is delayed beyond the bounded confirmation budget, Golden correctly reports the cached 2x2 first mismatch instead.\n\nControl the pending confirmation explicitly, preserving real asynchronous capture coverage and the original deadline. Assert the expired budget, pending second capture, 2x2-to-4x4 transition, exactly two attempts, and successful attachment behavior without changing production retries or tolerances.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

5685.title: [skia-sync] Update skia to milestone 159
5685.body:
[M159] Update SkiaSharp to Skia m159 (#5685)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/443
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/e9296dd4eb471f50a09e462f3a33bf276e5c95e4...1b7b8c4340f57877940b47d24ada18eb6ec66e68

Adopt the m159 native engine, bringing WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization,
Windows font-loading improvements, and image/rendering correctness fixes.

Align SkiaSharp package and assembly identities with 4.159 and the native
library version with m159. Native HarfBuzz remains 15.0.0; HarfBuzzSharp
packages receive the per-milestone revision 15.0.0.100.

Update component provenance for Skia and Vulkan-Headers 1.4.368, and
update the Uno CPU reference images for m159's rendering changes.
C API exports and public managed signatures remain unchanged.

5700.title: Retire .NET 8 WASM and obsolete Emscripten workarounds
5700.body:
Retire .NET 8 WASM and obsolete Emscripten workarounds (#5700)

Context: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/446

Retire the .NET 8 WebAssembly toolchain while preserving the runtime-matched
archives for supported consumers. Non-WASM .NET 8 support and the existing
native Dawn integration remain unchanged.

~~ Require .NET 9 for WebAssembly native assets ~~

Remove emsdk 3.1.34 producer jobs, both artifact-merger registrations and
the corresponding native artifact inventory. Update source-build and
packaged targets for SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp to reject unsupported
WASM frameworks before building.

Keep .NET 9/10 on emsdk 3.1.56 and .NET 11+ on 6.0.2, preserving threading
and SIMD selection. Newer archives are not interchangeable with older
.NET toolchains. Current package and developer documentation now describes
this support boundary; historical release records remain intact.

MSBuild coverage verifies retained archive selection, unsupported WASM
errors and unaffected non-WASM builds. Retired archive directories remain
as test decoys so their accidental selection is detectable.

~~ Use the existing modern WebGPU integration consistently ~~

The retained WASM toolchains already use emdawnwebgpu. Remove the obsolete
_SkiaSharpUseEmdawnwebgpu discriminator, built-in USE_WEBGPU linkage and
legacy mgrDevice/mgrQueue/mgrTexture fallbacks.

Continue shipping the matching port JavaScript and exporting instance
creation and texture release. Browser test interop now uses importJs*
handles directly and releases textures through wgpuTextureRelease rather
than silently accepting a missing release path.

Keep the existing native Dawn adaptations, old-toolchain JavaScript
compatibility rewrite and runtime library-order workaround. Their
requirements do not disappear with .NET 8.

~~ Remove inactive native build switches ~~

Drop SKNX_NO_SIMD, SK_DISABLE_AAA and GR_GL_CHECK_ALLOC_WITH_GET_ERROR from
the WASM build flags: the pinned native source has no tracked consumers.
SIMD selection continues through the compiler's -msimd128 flag.

The retired toolchain was also the reason for the Graphite version gate.
Graphite now follows the existing GPU setting, preserving GPU-off builds.

~~ Restore upstream PDF and SVG ranges implementations ~~

Pin mono/skia e9296dd4eb471f50a09e462f3a33bf276e5c95e4 in both the
submodule and Component Governance registration. The landed native tree
equals the reviewed tree and restores std::views::reverse in PDF structure
emission and projected std::ranges::find in SVG blend-mode selection.

Both restored translation units compile on emsdk 3.1.56 and 6.0.2 across
threading and SIMD variants. Source-built single-threaded archives link
with the retained .NET toolchains; these checks do not establish complete
browser runtime coverage.

The unfiltered managed solution passes. Browser validation has separate
documented limitations, and the unrelated Windows sample confirmation
timeout is being investigated independently rather than weakened here.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
